description: Villa Kirara is a pool-villa enclave by The Title Residence, offered in five plan types (Aura, Selene, Lyra, Myrrah, Xenia) with 360-degree virtual tours. The developer's site reports construction progress at 15.03% as of October 2026, with piling complete.

researchNotes: Official page has no price, sizes, bedrooms, facilities. Unit counts disagree (37 per Lazudi/Hipflat, 75 per one DDProperty text). Completion dates in portals conflict (2026-01-01 Lazudi vs Jun 2026 Hipflat) and contradict the official 15% progress, so completionDate left null. Portal location Si Sunthon vs client Cherng Talay. Lazudi listings seen in search: 2BR/3BA 305 sqm, 3BR/4BA 395 sqm, 4BR/6BA 646 sqm (not opened). | Official page shows no price. Portal snippets (Lazudi, Thailand-Property; search results only, pages not opened) show range from 29,020,000 THB; a DDProperty listing shows a 3BR unit at 36,100,000, so the claimed 36.1M is a specific unit price, not the minimum. Verify with sales. | claimed price 36100000 | Phase 4 (2026-11-19) a property portal fields filled where empty: completionDate. a property portal is a portal; values not confirmed by the developer. | Phase 4: privatePool set to yes from the project description ("pool villas"). | Phase 4 (2026-11-19) portal unit listings (a sample, may not cover every unit type) used for: bedrooms, bathrooms, built-up area. Property portal audit 2026-11-21: starting price, units advertised, completion, floors/buildings and unit table taken from the portal project and listing pages (unit table replaced).
